Collision-Aware Bin-Picking
Robot design, control, and grasp strategies that account for interference in heavily cluttered scenes.
Design and grasping under interference

workshop abstract and co-first-author journal paper.

heavily cluttered scenes.
2.
Tested gripper/robot design and control strategies
in physical picking experiments.
3.
Documented competition experiments in an IROS
extended abstract and a follow-up journal paper.

pages.text:
04  /  COMPLIANT CONTROL / TELEOPERATION
Bilateral Teleoperation
Bilateral arm-and-hand teleoperation with leader-arm force feedback and compliant robot control.
Remote contact feedback to the leader
Leader gravity compensation, current/torque control,
and force reflection; M0609 disturbance, gravity,
tool, and friction compensation.
1.
Mapped remote wrench to leader joint torque
using the Jacobian transpose.
2.
Implemented a momentum-based disturbance
observer and compensation.
3.
Integrated arm-and-hand teleoperation for
contact-task demonstrations.
Dual-arm/hand teleoperation with force feedback · KRoC 2026 RED Show, 1st
(related team project)

pages.title: Grasping with IL
pages.text:
05  /  FORCE SENSING / IMITATION LEARNING
Grasping with IL
Force-based compliant control and Diffusion Policy for scooping and grasping.
Force-based contact control and learning
Fingertip wrench transforms, wrist force fusion,
compliant control, demonstration collection, policy
training, and deployment.
1.
Transformed fingertip forces and torques into the
wrist frame.
2.
Combined fingertip signals with wrist F/T feedback
for compliant control.
3.
Trained Diffusion Policy from demonstrations and
tested scooping with objects of different sizes.
Surface-assisted scooping and lifting; motion comparison with and without
compliant control.
Force / Torque · ROS TF · Diffusion Policy
Fingertip/wrist forces for compliant control | Policy rollouts and control comparison available online
Details

pages.title: Learning from Human Corrections
pages.text:
06  /  HUMAN CORRECTIONS / RESIDUAL LEARNING
Learning from Human Corrections
Online residual learning from physical human corrections during insertion.
Learning from physical corrections
Residual model on a frozen base policy; online
learning and execution loop using physical
correction data.
1.
Added a residual head predicting Δpose to the
base policy output.
2.
Used human-corrected robot poses as supervised
targets.
3.
Implemented asynchronous actor-learner updates
and output limits; evaluated insertion.
Base + residual box-insertion evaluation at the original target and a target shifted 3
cm backward.
Residual Policy · Online DAgger · PyTorch
Original target and 3 cm backward shift | Outside base-training positions; residual zero-shot not established

pages.title: Grasping with RL
pages.text:
07  /  SYSTEM ID / SIM-TO-REAL
Grasping with RL
RL training with identified arm and controller responses, followed by real-robot grasping and lifting.
Grasp and lift with object-pose and target overlays
Compliant contact response (lift incomplete)
Arm/controller response identification, impedance model integration, RL
training, and real-robot deployment.
Object grasping and tabletop lifting with a Doosan M0609 and
AIDIN robotic hand.
1.
Identified closed-loop responses including arm dynamics, payload, friction,
and delay.
2.
Integrated impedance responses for contact-impact mitigation into the
Isaac Sim training environment.
3.
Connected policy observations and commands to the robot; checked
fingertip observation ordering.
Left: grasp and lift | Right: contact response in a separate RL trial (lift incomplete)
